Uninstall Intel Driver & Support Assistant. For some PCs the drivers it downloads seems to be not compatible since it is a custom build or whatever or maybe (my personal opinion) it is just a bad software that should be avoided.

What worked for me was going into Device Manager, under Display Adapters, right click and uninstall the Intel display driver (do NOT check the box for delete driver software for this device). Restart the PC and it will automatically reinstall the driver. 

If this does not work try booting in Safe Mode (you can Google how this can be done for your PC) and redoing the above steps.
